Figure 7.5: Example of diagnostic event usage
An
event
represents a specific diagnostic monitoring performed which is unique within
the system and DM only supports notifications for a certain
event
from one single
source. This implies that only one application can report a certain
event
and the
event
reporting interface is explicitly not re-entrant.
The available
events
are derived from
DiagnosticEvent
.
The DM provides two types of interfaces that can be used from an AA to read infor-
mation for an event. The
ara::diag::Event
interface provides operations that are
assigned for one single event, that is mapped via
DiagnosticEventPortMapping
.
For each
DiagnosticEvent
the AA needs to instantiate exactly one
ara::diag::
